web-guide-idea-98.audience: Families and elders who enjoy exchanging memories.
web-guide-idea-98.offer: Moderate a consenting story circle with a warm pace and respectful listening. The value is giving each storyteller space.
web-guide-idea-98.steps.0: Invite a theme such as school days or first jobs.
web-guide-idea-98.steps.1: Give each willing elder time to tell a story.
web-guide-idea-98.steps.2: Invite gentle questions and close with a shared reflection.
web-guide-idea-98.equipment: A phone and clear sound. Photos are optional prompts; recording requires separate agreement.
web-guide-idea-98.returnReason: Choose a new life theme each time and let storytellers guide the pace.
web-guide-idea-98.promotion: Share example prompts, not personal stories from previous participants.
